overview.text: The OCA’s calendar places All Saints of Russia on the second Sunday after Pentecost. The assembly is distinct from the universal feast of All Saints.
overview.reason: Necessary concise source-bound explanation;substantial modern text is not established as freely reproducible. This is an AI-written summary,not the source author’s wording.

blocks.text: The modern Eleon workshop composition arranges many groups of saints around central sacred figures and architectural settings. Bishops, monastics, martyrs and rulers appear in ordered ranks. Its contemporary design is identified honestly; the image is not relabelled an ancient surviving panel.
